title: Tandoori Chicken Scotch Egg Biryani Naan-rito
summary: An over-the-top mash-up the creator himself frames as a 'social media cross section': cheddar-rich tandoori chicken thighs wrapped in slow-proofed naan, chopped kottu-roti style, used to scotch-egg a jammy boiled egg (beer batter, blitzed poppadoms for crumb), then loaded onto garlic naan with lamb biryani, curry sauce and slaw and rolled into a naan-rito. The whole method is narrated but no quantities are given on any surface.

ingredients.note: Narration: 'the obvious first step is to use chicken thighs, the best bit of meat on the bird.' Skin/bone-in vs fillet and count not specified.
'using cheddar cheese in the tandoori marinade overnight ... so it oozes out fat as it cooks and smothers the meat.' Quantity unstated.
Referred to as 'the tandoori marinade'; its component spices/yogurt are not itemized in the video.

steps.text: Start with chicken thighs — the creator's stated first step for the juiciest tandoori chicken.

Add cheddar cheese into the tandoori marinade and marinate the thighs overnight, so the cheese oozes fat as it cooks and smothers the meat. Marinade time is 'overnight'; no temperature or cook time for the chicken itself is given.

ingredients.note: 'always slow proof in the fridge for optimal gluten development.' Dough ingredients/quantities not given.
'brushing with garlic butter.' Butter-to-garlic ratio and quantity unstated.

steps.text: Slow-proof the naan dough in the fridge for optimal gluten development.

Maximise surface contact by wrapping the naan around the tandoori chicken for the final couple of minutes of the cook, deliberately leaving gaps for the steam to escape, and brushing it with garlic butter.

ingredients.note: 'boiled my egg for six minutes and into ice ... for a nice and jammy yolk.' Egg count unstated; six minutes is a time, not a quantity.
'whisk a quick beer batter to dip in.' Other batter ingredients (e.g. flour) are implied but not spoken; not added.
'blitz up my poppadoms to use instead of panko' as the crumb coating. Quantity unstated.

steps.text: Chop the cooked cheesy tandoori chicken and naan up, kottu roti style.
Boil the egg for six minutes, then plunge into ice, for a nice jammy yolk.
Envelop the jammy egg with the cheesy tandoori chicken and naan mix.
Whisk a quick beer batter and dip the wrapped egg in it.
Blitz the poppadoms and use them instead of panko to crumb the battered egg, forming little tandoori chicken scotch eggs.
Cook the scotch eggs until golden (a fryer/air-fryer basket is shown removing two breaded scotch eggs). No frying temperature or time is stated.

ingredients.note: 'pop onto a freshly made garlic naan.' Size/count unstated.
'along with some lamb biryani' — a prepared accompaniment, not made in this video; recipe/quantity out of scope here.
'curry sauce' to add; type and quantity unstated.
'and slaw to fold'; composition and quantity unstated.

steps.text: Pop the fried tandoori chicken scotch eggs onto a freshly made garlic naan.
Add lamb biryani, curry sauce and slaw on top.
Fold, roll and wrap it up into the tandoori scotch egg biryani naan-rito.
